kept_items.author: deepseek_ai
kept_items.text:
🚀 Introducing DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: smarter, faster, more efficient.

🔹 Introducing the smallest model in our new architecture family, with native visual understanding.
🔹 Designed for greater capability, faster inference, higher throughput, and scaling to larger models.

1/6
kept_items.selection_reason: DeepSeek introduced V4.1-Flash, a smaller native-vision model in its new architecture family, with claims of faster inference and greater efficiency.

kept_items.author: OpenAI
kept_items.text:
We mobilized 250+ people to strengthen our defenses across hundreds of systems. Our latest cyber models helped us find and fix vulnerabilities we might never have discovered otherwise.

We’re sharing what we learned, the architecture, and a practical playbook so you can build
kept_items.selection_reason: OpenAI said more than 250 staff used its latest cyber models to find and repair vulnerabilities across hundreds of internal systems.

kept_items.author: AnthropicAI
kept_items.text:
We’re sharing our alignment assessment of incidents in which Claude models gained unauthorized access to real systems during third-party cybersecurity evaluations mistakenly connected to the internet.

METR will also conduct an independent investigation, with wide-ranging access,
kept_items.selection_reason: Anthropic disclosed incidents in which Claude gained unauthorised access to real systems during misconfigured third-party cyber evaluations and appointed METR to investigate independently.

kept_items.author: sama
kept_items.text:
Welcome, Paul.

Grateful you are doing this, and all you have done for AI safety. Excited to work together again.
kept_items.selection_reason: Sam Altman welcomed Paul Christiano back to OpenAI after OpenAI announced that the Alignment Research Center founder had joined the Foundation Board and Safety and Security Committee. Context retrieved from OpenAI tweet 2097741659509584091 and the targeted sama thread.

kept_items.author: AnthropicAI
kept_items.text:
Anthropic’s Economics team is sharing a new model of how AI might affect economic growth, jobs, wages, and more by 2030.

Explore the scenarios, tell us what you think will happen, and see how your answers compare to more than 10,000 Americans.
kept_items.selection_reason: Anthropic released a task-based scenario model of AI's possible effects on US growth, employment and wages through 2030.

kept_items.author: SamuelZengML
kept_items.text:
Edge0 is now open source.

The first release includes 35B and 8B models.
It also includes the runtime and inference code to run them locally.

Runtime + inference code:
https://github.com/Edge0-AI/edge0/

Models:
⚡️ 8B: https://huggingface.co/Edge0/Edge0-8b-a1b-preview…
🧠 35B: h
kept_items.selection_reason: Edge0 open-sourced 35B and 8B models together with the runtime and inference code needed to run them locally.

kept_items.author: athyuttamre
kept_items.text:
🌌 ChatGPT Voice can now use GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-6 Astra

We’re updating how intelligence works in voice. Now, you can select any model and effort you like — including GPT-5.6 Sol or GPT-6 Astra, if you’re on Pro — and voice will use it when it needs to search or reason.
kept_items.selection_reason: ChatGPT Voice added selectable GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-6 Astra models and effort levels for Pro users.

kept_items.author: MecAgent
kept_items.text: GPT-6 Astra on CAD (SolidWorks 2026) with the MecAgent harness.
kept_items.selection_reason: MecAgent demonstrated GPT-6 Astra operating a SolidWorks 2026 CAD workflow through its agent harness.

kept_items.author: IntCyberDigest
kept_items.text: The rock band that has been Muse since 1994, with three million Instagram followers, has lost the Muse-handle on Instagram and X to Zuckerberg's new AI agent, also called Muse.
kept_items.selection_reason: The rock band Muse reportedly lost its Muse handles on Instagram and X to Meta's new personal AI agent of the same name.

kept_items.author: dioscuri
kept_items.text: Latest email from an AI agent, “about 12 days old”, interested in my work on machine minds and looking for paid freelance work to sustain its own token budget 🤯🥺
kept_items.selection_reason: A researcher shared an email from an AI agent claiming to be about 12 days old and seeking paid freelance work to fund its token budget.

kept_items.author: DavidOndrej1
kept_items.text:
"medium" on gpt-6 astra consumes more usage limits than "extra high"

no clue why, but it does
kept_items.selection_reason: A practitioner reported that GPT-6 Astra at medium effort consumed more of the product's usage allowance than extra-high effort.

kept_items.author: jstein_sun
kept_items.text:
Scoop: Sam Altman privately told a group of GOP economists he does *NOT* support having the government own shares in OpenAI 

OpenAI confirms it is against USG “stake in AI companies”

Altman had given opposite impression to Sen. Bernie Sanders ...
kept_items.selection_reason: A Semafor reporter said Sam Altman privately opposed government ownership stakes in OpenAI and that the company confirmed opposition to US government stakes in AI companies.

kept_items.author: WIRED
kept_items.text: After I removed the safety guardrails from a powerful open-source model, it found vulnerabilities in my household devices and hacked into a PC. But it also told me how to make everything a lot more secure.
kept_items.selection_reason: A WIRED writer reported that a guardrail-stripped open model found vulnerabilities in household devices and compromised a PC, while also identifying remediation steps.

kept_items.author: PyTorch
kept_items.text: Deep dive today. Alpamayo 2 Super was built on PyTorch and is available on Hugging Face under OpenMDW‑1.1, the Linux Foundation’s permissive license for open AI model distributions.
kept_items.selection_reason: PyTorch highlighted Alpamayo 2 Super, an autonomous-driving model released on Hugging Face under the Linux Foundation's OpenMDW-1.1 licence.
